_template: Template only, not a board. `/giga-workflow:epic-plan <EPIC-KEY>` seeds a new board from it through `workflow.boardTemplate` in `.claude/giga/config.json`, dropping every `_` key. The filename deliberately does not match `epic.*.json`, so no epic skill reads it as a board. The Jira project is NGE; ticket content lives in the plans repo as `nge/<KEY>.md`, and Jira holds status only.
_workspaceShapes: Library/Storybook epic (the common case here): app=apps/storybook-app, libraries.ui=libs/shared/<lib>, buildCommand='npx nx run storybook-app:build-storybook'. Ledger demo-app epic: app=apps/ledger/app, libraries.ui=libs/ledger/ui, libraries.store=libs/ledger/store, libraries.designLibrary=libs/ledger/design-library, routingFiles=['apps/ledger/app/src/app/app.routes.ts'], buildCommand='npm run b.app.ledger'.
name: <epic summary, e.g. NgeChart layer expansion>
conventions: DI via inject(); signal inputs/outputs via input() / output() — never constructor injection or @Input() / @Output()
Separate .ts / .html / .scss / .spec.ts files per component — never inline template or styles
Component-scoped @ngrx/signals SignalStore for internal reactive state, provided at the component and colocated with it; design-library primitives keep intrinsic widget mechanics (CVA internals)
Tailwind utility classes by default; SCSS + BEM only for complex layout/animation Tailwind cannot express
No Angular Material — @angular/material is not installed and must never be added; own-namespace CSS-var tokens (--nge-* / --dlc-*) with literal defaults instead, never mat-* / --mat-sys-*
Design-library components: ViewEncapsulation.None + host class, SCSS wrapped in .dlc-<component> (never :host), dlc- selector prefix
Verify through Nx — this repo has no npm lint/test scripts: `npx nx affected -t lint test` (one project: `npx nx run <project>:lint` / `:test`), plus `npm run build-storybook` for UI work
